results.name: Unbound real review sources yield an honest empty advisory report with no reward or adventure penalty
Known facts, current access, release, 6.5 target and training partition filter before any title is returned
Uncalibrated, unavailable, synthetic-authority and regression-only assets cannot masquerade as verified practice
At most three recommendations preserve distinct family, goal and topic; an explicit request has first priority
Refusal survives the next safe opportunity and uncertain clock; only a deliberate new request overrides it
Protected input and unsafe windows suppress all suggestions, including explicit requests
Automatic practice excludes exposed families; deliberate repetition remains practice and never a new transfer source
Intervals advance only once per independently successful new family; repeats and unassessed outcomes cannot postpone indefinitely
Clock anomalies leave outcome history intact and timing unverified, without offline-day decay
Supports bind submission time and target; text paths and structured confirmation remain distinct from independent language
Canonical families defeat renaming and hashes; delayed transfer requires three families and verified real elapsed time
Two distinct recent confirmed difficulties suggest review without erasing successes; one-family retries do not
Actual privacy erasure or load change while projecting suggestions discards output with no world transaction
